verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost the same, and both are broken. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the body copy, so the reading order is jumbled. The RSVP CTA is shrunk to badge size in the same row, so it no longer stands out. 'Saturday 21 June' and the time line are left-aligned while everything else is centred, giving ragged edges. The small legal text sits on top of the planet graphic. A grey dot collides with the logo wordmark ('SOLST CE'). The stacked text is cramped into the middle while the left and right areas are mostly empty. B is slightly worse because its headline is pushed right, off the logo and copy axis, so it crowds the product can. A keeps the headline centred under the logo.
